usage: agentware learn [-h] [--format {text,json}] --topic TOPIC
                       --summary SUMMARY --tags TAGS --content CONTENT
                       [--author AUTHOR] [--source SOURCE] [--to-shared]
                       [--force] [--title TITLE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --topic TOPIC         filename stem under learnings/
  --summary SUMMARY     one-line summary
  --tags TAGS           comma-separated tags
  --content CONTENT     learning body, or '-' to read from stdin
  --author AUTHOR       optional provenance author handle (default: the per-
                        user handle if set, else the operator handle). For
                        shared/team KBs.
  --source SOURCE       optional provenance source: user|agent|imported
                        (default: agent). Feeds the ACR source_weight prior.
  --to-shared           write org-wide into shared/ (curator only, CR-gated);
                        default writes go to the caller's team.
  --force               record even if a near-duplicate existing learning is
                        detected
  --title TITLE         optional display title (default: derived from --topic
                        via title-casing)
